s.h: The role of a Technical and Reporting Accountant at Canonical
s.t:
If you are passionate about the technology industry and want to work for a company that aligns with your interests, we might be the place for you! Canonical, and our world class Ubuntu product, attracts some of the leading talent from around the world. Come and work with exceptional people and advance your career in Finance!
Our Finance team is growing and it's a really exciting time to join the team. We are looking for bright, motivated people who have a passion for making a difference. You will be seeking an opportunity to drive process improvements and change, input your ideas and truly contribute to a highly productive team.
We are looking for an exceptional Technical and Reporting Accountant with IFRS experience to help us ready the business for public market scrutiny through our planned IPO. The right candidate will have domain expertise and a passion for IFRS.
Location: This role may be office based in London, or Remote in EMEA Time Zones.

s.h: What your day will look like
s.t:
Research and interpret new and existing accounting standards
Provide technical accounting advice for complex transactions
Draft accounting papers and policy documentation
Monitor regulatory changes and assess their impact on the business
Assist with the year end external audit process and support the internal audit team
Assist in the month end reporting process to deliver timely and accurate information to management
Ensure compliance with relevant accounting standards (e.g. IFRS, local GAAP)
Assist in the preparation of statutory accounts and annual reports across multiple subsidiaries and jurisdictions
Support the finance team's wider plans to prepare for an IPO
Improve the efficiency of financial processes and procedures and monitor compliance
Share knowledge between team members to ensure cover is available when needed
Actively develop your own skills to ensure current knowledge of applicable standards and regulations
Establish strong relationships with key colleagues outside the wider finance team

s.h: What we are looking for in you
s.t:
Exceptional academic track record and subsequent career performance.
Bachelor's degree in Accounting or equivalent.
Qualified accountant (ACCA, ACA, ACMA, CPA, etc.).
Strong knowledge of IFRS and local GAAP.
Experience in financial reporting and statutory accounts preparation.
Experience at a large public accounting firm, or public multinational corporate accounting department preferred.
NetSuite or similar enterprise grade systems experience.
Business level written and spoken English.

s.h: Sincere personal motivation aligned with our mission.
s.t: International travel 2-4 times a year for company events up to two weeks long.

s.h: In addition we expect that you will match our values, by being
s.t:
Precise, taking care to deliver correctness and clarity.
Reliable, delivering high quality work that builds trust and confidence.
Accessible, collaborating to build products and systems that are usable.
Adroit, blending enthusiasm, knowledge, adaptability, style and character.

We encourage you to read this entire vacancy announcement prior to submitting your application. As a Accountant GS-0510-13, you will be responsible for Ensures implementation internal control program(s): identifies problem areas and develops solutions to improve operating program effectiveness.

Generates a variety of financial reports; recommends the establishment of policies and procedures affecting the accounting system or accounting policies. Assists management in applying financial data and recommends alternatives to resolve difficult problems.

Develops and updates procedural instructions to support the development or implementation of accounting policies, reviews, analyzes, and validates financial and statistical data.

Reconciles cash, accounts receivable, accounts payable, and other general ledger accounts; corrects all differences between the subsidiary ledger balances and the control account balances in the general ledger.

As a Accountant GS-0510-14, you will be responsible for Develops and monitors accounting internal control program(s): identifies problem areas, and develops solutions to improve operating program effectiveness.

Formulates a variety of financial reports; develops the establishment of policies and procedures affecting the accounting system or accounting policies. Advises management on applying financial data and recommends alternatives to resolve difficult problems.

Prepares procedural instructions for the development or implementation of accounting policies, reviews, analyzes, and validates financial and statistical data.

Reconciles cash, accounts receivable, accounts payable, and other general ledger accounts; corrects all differences between the subsidiary ledger balances and the control account balances in the general ledger.
Minimum Qualification Requirements You may meet the minimum qualifications for the GS-13, if you possess the specialize experience, education, or a combination of the two.

Specialized Experience for the GS-13 One year of experience in either federal or non-federal service that is equivalent to at least a GS-12 performing two (2) out of three (3) of the following duties or work assignments: 1.

Experience in providing advice in varied areas of accounting, assisting in developing policies and financial management program goals, determining accounting data requirements, and developing procedural manuals, methods, and directives. 2.

Experience in reconciling various general ledger account or in assessing effectiveness of internal controls with minimal guidance or oversight. 3.

Experience in conducting financial analyses, audits, and/or investigations of public and/or private sector entities; reviewing, analyzing, and validating financial data; developing and coordinating surveys and systems for gathering, analyzing, and validating data; resolving accounting discrepancies in reported data.

You may meet the minimum qualifications for the GS-14, if you possess the specialize experience, education, or a combination of the two.

Specialized Experience for the GS-14 One year of experience in either federal or non-federal service that is equivalent to at least a GS-13 performing two (2) out of three (3) of the following duties or work assignments: 1.

Experience in providing subject matter expert advice and oversight in specialized areas of accounting, developing policies and financial management program goals, determining accounting data requirements, and developing procedural manuals, methods, and directives. 2.

Experience in providing subject matter expert advice and guidance to financial and program managers and other accountants on unusual and difficult accounting systems/internal controls and/or operations problems. 3.

Experience independently conducting financial analyses, audits, and/or investigations of major public and/or private sector entities; reviewing, analyzing, and validating financial data; developing and coordinating surveys and systems for gathering, analyzing, and validating data with minimal support; resolving accounting discrepancies in reported data.

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities (KSAs) The quality of your experience will be measured by the extent to which you possess the following knowledge, skills and abilities (KSAs).

You do not need to provide separate narrative responses to these KSAs, as they will be measured by your responses to the occupational questionnaire (you may preview the occupational questionnaire by clicking the link at the end of the Evaluations section of this vacancy announcement). GS-13 1.

Knowledge of organizational or program practices, policies, functions, and programs to advise managers on changing program operations. 2. Knowledge of accounting principles, practices, methods, and techniques to independently perform a variety of accounting assignments. 3.

Knowledge of Federal accounting regulations, procedures, policies, and precedents to carry out complex accounting functions. 4. Knowledge of generally accepted accounting principles of the United States to analyze financial data. 5.

Knowledge of Federal accounting regulations, procedures, policies, and precedents to carry out complex accounting functions. GS-14 1. Skill in developing organizational or program practices, policies, functions, and programs to advise managers on changing program operations.. 2.

Ability to exercise independent judgment along with planning, organizing, and directing the work of programs/projects requiring substantial personnel and financial resources. 3. Ability to review, analyze and evaluate automated and/or manual accounting and financial management systems. 4.

Ability to develop guidance, memoranda, procedures and instructions which cover the full spectrum of accounting and financial management issues. 5. Knowledge of financial management, fiscal and accounting theories, concepts, principles, and procedures, and generally accepted accounting principles and standards in the United States.

Basic Requirements: This position has a positive Education Requirement in addition to at least one year of Specialized Experience or substitution of education for experience or combination (if applicable) in order to be found minimally qualified. Transcripts must be submitted with your application package.

You MUST meet the following requirements: EDUCATION: Degree: accounting; or a degree in a related field such as business administration, finance, or public administration that included or was supplemented by 24 semester hours in accounting. The 24 hours may include up to 6 hours of credit in business law.

(The term "accounting" means "accounting and/or auditing" in this standard.

Similarly, "accountant" should be interpreted, generally, as "accountant and/or auditor.") OR Combination of education and experience: at least 4 years of experience in accounting, or an equivalent combination of accounting experience, college-level education, and training that provided professional accounting knowledge.

The applicant's background must also include one of the following: Twenty-four semester hours in accounting or auditing courses of appropriate type and quality. This can include up to 6 hours of business law.

A certificate as Certified Public Accountant or a Certified Internal Auditor, obtained through written examination; or Completion of the requirements for a degree that included substantial course work in accounting or auditing, e.g., 15 semester hours, but that does not fully satisfy the 24-semester-hour requirement of paragraph A, provided that (a) the applicant has successfully worked at the full-performance level in accounting, auditing, or a related field, e.g., valuation engineering or financial institution examining; (b) a panel of at least two higher level professional accountants or auditors has determined that the applicant has demonstrated a good knowledge of accounting and of related and underlying fields that equals in breadth, depth, currency, and level of advancement that which is normally associated with successful completion of the 4-year course of study described in paragraph A; and (c) except for literal nonconformance to the requirement of 24 semester hours in accounting, the applicant's education, training, and experience fully meet the specified requirements.

AND To qualify at the GS-07 grade level, applicants must have at least one (1) full year of specialized experience equivalent to at least the GS-05 grade level in the federal sector.

Specialized experience is experience that has equipped you with the particular ability, skill, and knowledge to successfully perform the duties of this position and is typically in or related to this line of work. Specialized experience must include the following: Review accounting data to assist with examination of accounting data.

Use automated accounting systems to assist in identifying incorrect data. or 1 full year of graduate level education or superior academic achievement To qualify at the GS-09 grade level, applicants must have at least one (1) full year of specialized experience equivalent to at least the GS-07 grade level in the federal sector.

Specialized experience is experience that has equipped you with the particular ability, skill, and knowledge to successfully perform the duties of this position and is typically in or related to this line of work.: Examine accounting data in preparation for validation. Assist in improving financial operations through issue resolution.

Identify incorrect data in automated accounting system files. Assist in validating interface data within official accounting systems.

OR at least one of the following if using education to qualify at this grade level: (A) Have a master's or equivalent graduate degree; OR (B) 2 full years of progressively higher level graduate education, if related; OR (C) A law degree such as an LL.B. or J.D, if related; OR(D) A combination of education and experience which together totals 100%.

To qualify at the GS-11 grade level, applicants must have at least one (1) full year of specialized experience equivalent to at least the GS-09 grade level in the federal sector.

Specialized experience is experience that has equipped you with the particular ability, skill, and knowledge to successfully perform the duties of this position and is typically in or related to this line of work. Analyze accounting data in preparation for validation. Develop instruction for accounting procedures.

Update incorrect data in files using automated accounting systems. Validate interface data within official accounting systems.

OR at least one of the following if using education to qualify at this grade level:(A) Ph.D. or equivalent doctoral degree; OR(B) 3 full years of progressively higher level graduate education leading to such a degree or LL.M., if related.(C) A combination of education and experience which together totals 100%.Combining experience and education: Experience and education combinations are computed by first determining the total qualifying experience as a percentage of the experience required for the grade level; then determining the total of qualifying education as a percentage of the education required for the grade level; and then adding the two percentages.

The total percentages must equal at least 100 percent to qualify at that grade level. NOTE: All experience statements (i.e., duties, specialized experience, or related applicable assessment) copied from this announcement and pasted into your resume will not be considered as a demonstration of your qualifications for this position.

NOTE: Education can be substituted for experience at the GS-07/09/11 grade level.

National Service Experience (i.e., volunteer experience): Experience refers to paid and unpaid experience, including volunteer work done through National Service programs (e.g., Peace Corps, AmeriCorps) and other organizations (e.g., professional, philanthropic, religious, spiritual, community, student, social).

Volunteer work helps build critical competencies, knowledge, and skills and can provide valuable training and experience that translates directly to paid employment. You will receive credit for all qualifying experience, including volunteer experience.

Qualifying specialized experience for the GS-09 includes the following: Using an automated system to review, adjust, or prepare accounting data in transaction files, ledgers, accounts, summary reports or financial statements; Analyzing a variety of accounting data sources (such as general ledger accounts) and adjusting discrepancies accordingly; Developing automated accounting instructions and procedures for routine transactions; Preparing, analyzing, interpreting and presenting accounting data; Assisting with the design, implementation, and assessment of internal control processes. -OR- Education: A master's or equivalent graduate degree; or have completed 2 full years of progressively higher-level graduate education leading to such a degree; or LL.B. or J.D., if related. -OR- Combination of experience and education: A qualifying combination of specialized experience and education as described above.

s.h: GOS AP Accountant Job Description Summary
s.t: The GOS AP Accountant is responsible for the comprehensive processing and maintenance of accounting data that flows to the property general ledger, with an emphasis on accuracy, efficiency, and adherence to internal controls. This role involves primarily supporting accounts payable and accounts receivable processes, and additional accounting tasks as needed. The GOS AP Accountant will work closely with Finance and Operations teams and other stakeholders. Job Description

Oversee and process accounts payable transactions within accounting software system (Yardi), ensuring accuracy and compliance.
Serve as a liaison for operations team and accounting verifying accuracy of third-party invoices.
Maintain a thorough understanding of general ledger accounts, identify and coordinate correction of coding errors.
Collaborate with accountants and management to manage critical turnaround items, including timing for issuing payments and resolving discrepancies.
Implement and maintain organized records and an efficient filing system, ensuring easy access documentation.
Lead follow-up efforts on inquiries, issues, and outstanding invoices, employing effective communication and problem-solving strategies.
Take the lead on internal projects, generating reports, and providing data-driven insights for decision-making and process improvements.
Perform other related duties as required or requested, including assuming additional responsibilities during peak periods.
High School Diploma, GED, Trade, Technical, or vocational school.

Minimum of 1-3 years of experience in accounting or a related field, with a demonstrated history of increasing responsibilities.
Proficiency with accounting software systems is required (Yardi experience is preferred)
Strong proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite, particularly Excel, and the ability to utilize 10-Key computer board efficiently.
Exceptional attention to detail, with a focus on accuracy and thoroughness in processing financial data.
Strong customer service skills with the ability to manage and resolve complex issues effectively.
Excellent organizational and time management skills, capable of prioritizing and managing a high-volume workload.
Proven ability to work independently and as part of a team, with strong interpersonal and leadership skills.
Advanced oral and written communication skills, with the ability to present information clearly and professionally.

· Ethical Conduct

· Priority Setting

· Customer/Client Focus

· Multi-Tasking and Time Management

· Problem Solving and Decision

Fachperson Finanz\- und Rechnungswesen 80\-100%
Im Zuge des Insourcings unseres Finanz\- und Rechnungswesens bauen wir die Buchhaltung neu innerhalb unserer Organisation auf. Deshalb suchen wir per sofort oder nach Vereinbarung eine engagierte Persönlichkeit als Fachperson Finanz\- und Rechnungswesen 80\-100%.
Du arbeitest gerne mit Zahlen, übernimmst Verantwortung und möchtest aktiv mitgestalten? In dieser vielseitigen Funktion führst du unsere Finanz\- und Lohnbuchhaltung eigenverantwortlich und trägst dazu bei, unsere internen Prozesse weiterzuentwickeln. Werde Teil unseres engagierten Teams am Standort Zürich\-Dietikon und leiste mit deiner Arbeit einen wichtigen Beitrag zu unserer sozialen Mission.
Was dich bei uns erwartet
Finanzbuchhaltung: Führen der laufenden Finanzbuchhaltung inklusive Hauptbuch sowie Kreditoren\- und Debitorenbuchhaltung
Betriebsbuchhaltung: Führung der Kostenstellenrechnung, Erstellung betriebswirtschaftlicher Auswertungen und Umsetzung des Controllings.
Selbstständige Erstellung oder Mitarbeit bei Monats\- Quartals\- und Jahresabschlüssen
Lohnbuchhaltung: Vorbereitung und Verarbeitung der monatlichen Lohnläufe sowie Pflege der Personalstammdaten sowie Abwicklung der Freizügigkeitsleistungen im Rahmen der beruflichen Vorsorge
Taggeldmanagement (UVG / KTG): Von der Schadensmeldung über die Überwachung der Taggeldzahlungen bis hin zur Lohnkontrollabstimmung
Budgetierung: Mitarbeit bei Budgetplanung, Forecasts und Liquiditätsplanung
Was du mitbringen solltest
Abgeschlossene kaufmännische Grundausbildung sowie fundierte Weiterbildung im Bereich Rechnungswesen (z. B. eidg. Fachausweis in Finanz\- und Rechnungswesen)

An accounting brain. A soft spot for better systems.
Job postings are funny
They are often part wish list, part sales pitch, and part collection of phrases no human has ever used in conversation. That does not tell you what the work feels like, who you will work with, or whether you will actually enjoy being here. We would rather be honest, so here is the real story.
About PracticeDen and R.D. Barnett PLLC
PracticeDen grew out of R.D. Barnett PLLC, the tax, accounting, and advisory firm Dean Barnett founded to help entrepreneurs and privately held businesses make smarter financial decisions. Years of sitting beside business owners - not just filing returns for them - made one thing clear: independent veterinary practice owners deserved an advisor who understood both the numbers and the wonderfully complicated business behind them.
That is where PracticeDen comes in. We connect the entire financial picture, from the operating practice and related real estate to the owner's individual tax situation. We work with veterinary owners as they start, buy, operate, grow, and eventually transition their practices. The goal is bigger than accurate filings. We want our clients to understand their numbers, spot opportunities earlier, make confident decisions, and spend less time wondering what their accountant is talking about.
PracticeDen is the veterinary-focused brand of R.D. Barnett PLLC. It is not a separate firm or a tax-only team. This role has a functional home in Tax and works across PracticeDen with accounting, advisory, and client-service teammates so the practice, related real estate, and owner return tell one coherent story.

We are looking for an experienced, hard-working, and self-motivated Senior Tax Associate who can prepare a wide variety of returns, hand off thoughtful, reviewer-ready work, and help us make tax season run a little smarter. You will work across entity and individual clients, often following the numbers across a veterinary practice, related real estate, and the owner's personal return.
This role reports to Liz Sandstrom, EA, Tax Manager. Liz leads the tax side of PracticeDen and will be your primary coach, reviewer, supervisor, and escalation point. You will own day-to-day execution, workpaper quality, status visibility, and early issue identification. Liz will set technical direction, approve material positions, and help you grow toward greater independence, planning exposure, client leadership, and review responsibility.
Tax preparation is the main event. You will gather information, build workpapers, prepare calculations and returns, support planning, handle e-filing and delivery, research unusual issues, and help resolve notices or other technical projects. In other words: you will do real tax work from beginning to end, not spend your days moving numbers from one box to another without understanding why.
This is also not a stay-in-your-lane-forever role. While traditional accounting work won’t be your primary responsibility, a strong accounting brain is essential. You should be able to read a trial balance, understand the financial statements, reconcile important accounts, propose adjustments, and recognize when the accounting needs attention before a return can move forward. Recurring bookkeeping is not part of this role unless separately assigned and scoped.
As PracticeDen grows, this role can grow with it. We do not expect you to know every answer. We do expect you to be genuinely inquisitive with a solution-driven purpose: ask better questions, trace the issue to its source, and move toward a sensible answer. Prior veterinary-industry experience is welcome but not required. Curiosity about independent veterinary ownership is.
What You'll Actually Do
Make tax work look easy
Prepare the returns. All kinds of them. That includes federal, state, and local returns for individuals and closely held entities, with a core mix of Forms 1040, 1065, 1120-S, and 1120. It may also include trusts and estates, related real estate entities, and other returns as assigned.
Make review a pleasant experience. Build clean, complete workpapers with clear support, reconciliations, calculations, notes, and tie-outs. Your reviewer should not need detective training to follow your work.
Follow the financial trail. Connect practice, real estate, and individual filings so every related return tells the same story.
Bring an accounting brain to the return. Reconcile balance-sheet accounts, retained earnings, fixed assets, basis, owner activity, payroll, sales or excise tax, and other book-to-tax items that are part of the engagement.
Know what went into the software. Enter and validate tax data, carryforwards, fixed assets, prior-year items, and current-year activity in UltraTax CS or a comparable platform.
Raise your hand early. Spot missing information, inconsistencies, unusual issues, capacity concerns, and potential deadline problems before they become deadline-day surprises.
See the process through. Help with extensions, estimates, e-filing, secure delivery, tax notices, and the less-glamorous details that still have to be right.
Know when the work has changed. Recognize services outside the agreed scope and bring them to Liz before committing to additional work, fees, or timing.
Support planning without freelancing. Identify potential planning opportunities, research assigned questions, document the facts and authority, and bring clear recommendations and unresolved questions to Liz.
Use technology like you mean it
Make Excel earn its keep. Build traceable workpapers and useful analyses, clean up data, review trial balances, and propose journal entries without turning the workbook into a haunted house.
Pick up new tools quickly. Tax software, workflow platforms, portals, collaboration tools-if it makes the work better, you should be comfortable learning it.
Use AI thoughtfully, not blindly. Look for responsible ways to improve research, documentation, data handling, and repetitive workflows. Use only firm-approved systems, protect client information, verify every output, and remain accountable for the final work.

AND FOR THE GS-07 LEVEL: Applicants must have one year of specialized experience (equivalent to the GS-05 grade level) that demonstrates: (1) basic knowledge of general ledger accounts and with moderate guidance the ability to execute general accounting transactions and ensuring proper processing by validating the trial balance; (2) With moderate guidance generates a variety of financial reports for examination, analysis and preparing summary entries for processing the core accounting system; and (3) Ability to document basic accounting processes to assist in the preparation of standard operating procedures. -OR- Education Substitution: 1 year of graduate-level education (education must be related and clearly show that it provides the knowledge, skills, and abilities necessary to do the work; transcripts must be provided in application documents) -OR- Superior Academic Achievement: To qualify based on superior academic achievement, you must have completed the requirements for a bachelor's degree from an accredited institution AND 1) have a class standing in the upper third of the graduating class, 2) membership in a national scholastic honor society (excluding Freshman honor societies), or 3) must meet certain GPA requirements.

* Du stellst eine ordnungsgemässe Debitorenbuchhaltung inklusive Inkasso sicher.

The Senior Trade Accountant will be based in Geneva, Switzerland within the Accounting & Controlling Department, operating in a Trading & Shipping environment. The role is responsible for ensuring accurate, timely, and robust accounting and financial reporting in compliance with IFRS norms.
As a senior finance professional, the incumbent will play a key role in safeguarding the integrity of trading results, maintaining proper accounting books under IFRS, and supporting the business through high-quality financial analysis, reporting, and internal controls.

Bachelor's degree in Accounting or Finance, or an equivalent professional qualification (e.g. ACCA)
Work Experience
6 to 8 years of experience within a Commodity Trading environment.
Prior exposure to the Oil industry and/or a Trading & Shipping environment is a strong advantage.
Prior audit experience is a plus.
Language Skills
Fluent in both written and spoken English, French is a plus.
Functional Skills
Strong ability to analyse, interpret, and prepare financial statements in accordance with IFRS.
Proven ability to prepare, coordinate, and follow up on audit processes and requirements.
Strong analytical skills with the ability to review balance sheets, P&L accounts, and month-end/year-end closing activities.
Excellent knowledge of accounting systems and financial trading platforms.
Advanced IT literacy with excellent proficiency in Microsoft Office applications, particularly Excel.

1. Trade & Financial Accounting
Control and account for the accounting impact of paper trades.
Prepare detailed P&L analysis by voyage, ensuring inclusion of all primary and secondary costs.
Analyse and monitor overhead expenses.
Proactively identify incomplete or missing information and ensure timely completion and correction.
2. Reconciliations, Balance Sheet and P&L production and control
Reconcile balance sheet accounts, including but not limited to accounts receivable, accounts payable, banks, and intercompany balances.
Reconcile Accounting P&L to Trading P&L and investigate and resolve discrepancies.
Ensure accuracy, completeness, and integrity of accounting records.
Perform and resolve intercompany reconciliations.
3. Reporting, Audit & Compliance
Prepare monthly and quarterly management accounts.
Handle usual Year-end financial audit end-to-end process up to sign-off.
Ensure accurate organisation, maintenance, and control of accounting records and document flows.
Promote strong internal controls and compliance with internal policies and IFRS accounting standards.
4. Business Partnering
Liaise closely with all departments teams to resolve accounting discrepancies and ensure accurate data for proper accounting process.
Support Accounting initiatives, ad-hoc analyses, and continuous improvement projects.

Analytical Thinking
Demonstrates a strong analytical mindset with the ability to interpret large datasets, identify discrepancies, and resolve issues logically, efficiently, and accurately in a fast-paced trading environment.
Planning & Organizing
Rigorous attention to detail. Effectively prioritises activities, plans and tracks progress, and ensures objectives are delivered within agreed timelines and quality standards.
Collaboration
Demonstrated ability to collaborate effectively with stakeholders across multiple locations and departments. Strong interpersonal and communication skills with a constructive and solution-oriented approach.
Discretion
High level of discretion and confidentiality required due to access to sensitive commercial, financial, and strategic information. Ability to adapt to the company's culture and values.

### **Candidate Profile** ###
You hold a Master-s degree or equivalent qualification in Accounting, Finance or a related discipline and have at least 5 years of relevant professional experience.
Previous experience within energy, commodities or trading would be highly valued. Candidates from Big Four or similar audit/advisory environments with strong exposure to trading, financial instruments or complex transactional businesses are also encouraged to apply.
**You bring:**
* Strong accounting expertise and a good understanding of how transactions flow through a trading organisation.
* Previous exposure to commodity trading and/or derivatives accounting.
* Good knowledge of IFRS and/or relevant statutory accounting requirements.
* Strong analytical and reconciliation skills, with the ability to investigate complex issues and understand their root causes.
* A high level of autonomy and the ability to take ownership of topics from identification through to resolution.
* Strong stakeholder management and communication skills, with the confidence to interact with Trading, Finance, control functions, IT and auditors.
* Experience working with ERP and/or ETRM systems.
* Advanced Excel skills and a strong interest in data, digitalisation and process automation.
* Experience with Power Query, Power BI, SQL and/or Python would be a strong asset.
* Strong numerical and quantitative skills.
* A continuous improvement and project management mindset.
* Self-motivated, with a focus on enhancing processes, controls and operational efficiency.
* Full professional proficiency in English.
You are rigorous and analytical while remaining pragmatic and solution-oriented. You are comfortable operating in a fast-moving trading environment, managing competing priorities and working to demanding reporting deadlines.
You are naturally curious about how trading activity flows through systems and financial statements and are motivated not only by identifying issues, but by understanding their root causes and improving the underlying processes.
We are committed to meet the energy needs of a growing population and we are committed to the energy transition. The volatility of the energy trading markets requires excellence in risk management and a culture of innovation. We are fully embracing the digital revolution.
Our people flourish in an environment that promotes expertise, entrepreneurship spirit, agility and a purpose-driven culture, generating boundless opportunities to learn, grow and achieve collaborative success.
Reinforcing the competencies of our people is a key pillar of our culture: we train our people to ensure their development and we pledge to encourage safety in all our actions.
We look for passion, ambition and open-mindedness. While we evolve in a demanding industry that requests to be always on the edge, we cultivate a friendly workplace where our people feel good, where team spirit and respect guide our daily routine, where the diversity of our people and their skills create a nourishing experience for all of us.
### **Context & Environment** ###
**TotalEnergies Trading & Shipping operates at the heart of international energy markets, bringing together trading activities across a broad range of energy commodities and financial products.**
